title: Karl Wolfe run over before disclosure wave

tellings.quote: of so-called disclosure began in 2017, 2018, poor Carl Wolf was run over just the way John Mack was run over,

plain: Just as the wave of so-called disclosure, the public release of government UFO information, began in 2017 and 2018, a man named Karl Wolfe was run over by a vehicle, the same way the researcher John Mack had been. The researcher Jason Jorjani makes this link, suggesting that people tied to the subject die in suspiciously similar ways.
